explanation: Cooks simmer butter until its water boils off and the milk solids brown, then strain them out. Without water or solids, ghee keeps for months and takes higher heat.

claims.text: Ghee is not made from coconut oil, sesame oil or lard.
Ghee is made by simmering butter until its water evaporates and the milk solids brown, then straining them out.
Ghee keeps for months at room temperature and has a higher smoke point than butter.
